purpose: Fail-closed correction and deterministic reproduction of V13; no new signal or return translation.
economic_hypothesis: In a causally known broad BEAR state, improving breadth plus a stock-specific fast washout and completed-session active-demand ignition represents forced-supply transfer. BULL and TRANSITION hold cash.

market_state.BULL: both 20d/60d cross-sectional return medians > 0 and both positive-return shares > 0.50
market_state.BEAR: both 20d/60d cross-sectional return medians <= 0 and both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market_state.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state

signal.fast_capitulation: prior10_return <= -8%; window ends before signal session
signal.breadth_repair: completed-session positive-ret20 share exceeds its value five completed market sessions earlier

execution.entry: first legal open strictly after signal, no later than three market sessions

portfolio.event_order: legal open exits, then legal open entries, then intraday targets
